headline: Space Bunny soars to 21.9% — stealth's wild ride continues
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha hit an all-time high of 21.9% token share (day 2 of the streak), while DeepSeek holds steady at second with 21.3%. OpenAI's gpt-6-luna-20260922 and Anthropic's claude-opus-5.5-20260921 both set new personal records. Four models debuted in the top 50, including xAI's grok-4.7 and DeepSeek's v3.2.
highlights: stealth/space-bunny-alpha: 21.9% share, +1.0% in one day, +20.4% in a week — day 2 of refusing to give up the top spot
Top 2 (stealth + DeepSeek) now command 43.2% of all tokens
OpenAI's gpt-6-luna-20260922 jumped 3 ranks to #6 with a new personal high of 4.4%
Anthropic's claude-opus-5.5-20260921 climbed 10 ranks to #13, hitting 1.8% — a career peak
Zhipu AI down 7.8% week-over-week; Tencent down 4.6% in the same span
